text.en: 1. These Regulations may be cited as the Cattle (Licence Fees) Regulations.

2.—(1) Subject to paragraph (2), the fee payable for a licence under section 4 of the Act shall be —
(a)in the case of a licence in respect of a place for keeping not more than 15 head of cattle, $66 per year;
[S 788/2014 wef 01/01/2015]
(b)in the case of a licence in respect of a place for keeping more than 15 but not more than 50 head of cattle, $164 per year; and
[S 788/2014 wef 01/01/2015]
(c)in the case of a licence in respect of a place for keeping more than 50 head of cattle, $300 per year.
[S 561/2010 wef 01/12/1910]
[S 788/2014 wef 01/01/2015]
(2) The fee payable for a licence issued after 30th June in any year shall not be more than half the rate set out in paragraph (1).
3. The fee paid for a licence shall not be refunded upon the revocation or suspension of the licence.
